name: clef-model-router
description: Picks the Claude model and reasoning effort for each turn with Cloudflare Clef, a fast decision model on Workers AI.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: Your Cloudflare account ID (dashboard → Workers AI → Use REST API). Falls back to $CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: A Workers AI API token (dashboard → Workers AI → Use REST API → Create a Workers AI API Token). Kept in your system's secure credential store, never in settings.json. Falls back to $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: model[:effort] for the five difficulty levels, lowest first: trivial, simple, standard, hard, deep. Aliases (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or full model IDs.

announce.title: Show the route
announce.description: status: a line under the prompt. answer: a line under each answer. both, or off.

enabled.title: Routing enabled
enabled.description: Off: the mod stays loaded and leaves every request as Claude Code makes it.

log_prompts.title: Log prompt text
log_prompts.description: Include each prompt's text in the local log (off: only a hash and its length).
